name: Warped-Space SDF Ray Marching
definition: A ray marching technique where the scene geometry is defined in a sheared coordinate space (road space) to simplify building placement, with a safety factor applied to the distance field to ensure the marcher never tunnels through walls despite the non-Euclidean metric.
summary: Warped-Space SDF Ray Marching renders urban scenes by shearing geometry into road space and applying a safety factor to prevent tunneling through walls.
